title: Create unique URL slugs
summary: A publishing tool turns titles into URL-friendly slugs, but different titles can normalize to the same text. Generate deterministic unique slugs while following the collision rules in the exercise. Generate deterministic unique URL-friendly slugs from titles.
requirements: Lowercase ASCII characters, replace runs of non a-z0-9 with one hyphen, trim edge hyphens.
Use item for an empty result.
For repeats, append -2, -3, etc. until unique.
hints: Generate a normalized base slug first.
Track allocated slugs and increment the suffix until it is unused.
